title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - TENTCorridor
description: TEN-T Corridor (era:TENTCorridor's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents the TEN-T network classification of an element, including its network level, type of traffic, and associated European transport corridors.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TENTCorridor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

europeanTransportCorridor.description: Property. Indication of which European Transport Corridor the element belongs to. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'European Transport Corridors' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/european-transport-corridors/EuropeanTransportCorridors), 9 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

tentNetworkLevel.description: Property. Classification of the element according to its level in the Trans-European Transport Network (TEN-T). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'TEN-T Network Levels' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/ten-t-network-levels/TENTNetworkLevels), 3 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

typeOfTraffic.description: Property. Classification of the type of traffic carried on the element. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Traffic Types' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/traffic-types/TrafficTypes), 2 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.
